description: This record covers ACER's network tariff resources for electricity in the EU. National regulatory authorities fix or approve transmission or distribution tariffs or methodologies, which should be cost-reflective, transparent and non-discriminatory, and under the Electricity Regulation ACER provides and updates a report on tariff methodologies at least every two years. In May 2026 ACER launched the first edition of an electricity network tariff repository that brings tariff information from EU Member States into one platform to improve comparability of national approaches to network cost recovery. The page also lists reports: the April 2026 report on distribution system operator revenue setting practices, the March 2025 report on network tariff practices with summary tables of national practices, and earlier reports of January 2023, February 2021, December 2019, December 2015 and April 2014. Coverage is EU Member States. Access: web pages and PDFs, free; no licence is stated and the repository itself was not opened. Caveats: tariffs are set nationally and may change between editions. It suits economic and regulatory analysis of grid investment, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
